symptom: a loop whose body @position was written in canvas coordinates (loop at 1200,200, body at 1200,300) passed check and exec and got a 1310;380 box that grows with the loop's canvas x and covers its neighbours (upstream mendixlabs/mxcli#1935)
cause: inside a loop body @position is in the loop box's coordinates (ako/mxcli#2564), and without @size the builder sizes the box from its own edge to the body's right/bottom edge plus 50px; nothing told an author who wrote canvas coordinates
fix: MDL-LOOP01 warning: when more than half the box, and over 300px, would lie empty before the body on either axis, report it and give the shift that puts the first body node at (210, 80); a stated @size or a body without @position is not judged
insight: upstream proposed making @position canvas-relative everywhere (mendixlabs/mxcli#1942), which would silently move every body written from an older describe. A check on the existing convention catches the same mistake without changing what any script means. The threshold was calibrated against both sides: a deliberate 'outside the box' fixture fires, and 26 Studio Pro-authored loop bodies from the testapp's describe output do not
